subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session catalogs permanently advertise a core new-session target through the optional `createSession` capability, with provider-owned runtime-policy validation and catalog-targeted drafts locked to the validated default agent?
rationale: This expands the plugin SDK and gateway protocol rather than repairing an established contract, so implementation review cannot choose the permanent extension API on maintainer intent's behalf.

options.title: Approve the generic capability
options.body: Keep the optional capability, document its ownership and compatibility rules, and require providers to validate runtime policy before advertising it.

options.title: Narrow to ordinary creation
options.body: Retain per-agent sidebar actions and hierarchy changes but remove provider-native catalog creation until a broader catalog action API is designed.

options.title: Pause catalog creation
options.body: Defer the creation feature and duplicate suppression together if catalog-to-OpenClaw session ownership is not yet a stable product concept.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic capability
recommendation.body: Keep the optional capability, document its ownership and compatibility rules, and require providers to validate runtime policy before advertising it.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member is the assignee and current driver of the catalog, provider-policy, protocol, and UI design under review.
